unit_label: BRBL::MOD_APPENDIX::U01: Navigate RBI institutional powers,bank notes and monetary policy

payload.title: Institutional power differs from a current policy setting
payload.core_explanation_md:
The RBI Act index spans the institution constitution, permitted business, government banking, note issue, credit information, non-bank regulation and monetary-policy machinery. Start with the power or duty actually in issue. A monetary-policy committee provision is different from a banking-company licensing provision under another statute.

A statutory power does not itself state today policy rate, ratio or operational circular. Separate the exam-pinned statutory framework from current reference data and consult dated instruments for the latter. Record the authority, provision and effective date rather than attaching a changing number to an undated teaching card.

self_check.prompt_text: Does a power to set a policy parameter establish its current numerical value?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The current setting requires the applicable dated decision.

payload.stem_md: A lesson uses a current policy rate as if it were a permanent number written into the statutory-power heading. What must be separated?

options.text_md: Every rate from every law forever
options.explanation_md: The issue requires separating the particular statutory power from the dated policy setting, not an indiscriminate rule about every rate.
It does not determine the statutory value.

options.text_md: The statutory framework and the dated policy setting

payload.stem_md: A question concerns the RBI institutional note-issue power. Which research source is the appropriate starting point?

options.text_md: The relevant RBI Act provision and applicable instruments

options.explanation_md: It does not establish RBI statutory power.
It is not the source of the public power.
